info.description:
Onboarding profile, calorie calculation, program matching, and meal plan endpoints (Modules/AccountManagement). Import into Apidog as a Postman v2.1 collection.

Auth model: every endpoint below decodes the `sub` claim from the Bearer JWT (no signature verification yet) and maps it to a local `accounts` row via ResolveAccountFromToken middleware. Each folder below uses its own `sub` variable so runs don't collide with each other's onboarding state.

item.name: PATCH profile (onboarding step)
item.description:
Saves one onboarding step. Every field is persisted progressively/independently (no need to resend earlier fields). Passing {"skip": true} marks the profile as skipped without requiring the remaining fields. See the cases below for every step, the skip flow, and the validation error scenarios.

**Track re-matching:** once onboarding is completed, changing any of `gender`, `goal`, `fitness_level` or `workout_location` re-matches the account's track. On a different track the current program is closed (its progress is lost) and the new track's first program is assigned — not started. `program_changed` (top-level, next to `data`) is true when the account's current program changed; show the user a confirmation before sending such a change. A change that still matches the same track keeps the current program and its progress (program_changed = false).

item.name: GET profile
item.description: Returns the authenticated account's onboarding profile. Creates a fresh (not_started) profile on first call for a brand-new account. See the cases below for the auth/middleware edge cases (401s) and the fresh-account 200 case.

item.name: POST profile/calculate
item.description:
Triggered when the user taps 'Next' on the Goal screen. Calculates BMR/TDEE (all 4 activity levels)/ideal weight range, persists the goal-adjusted daily_calorie_target, marks onboarding_status completed, and matches the account's track on `gender`, `goal`, `fitness_level` and `workout_location` (the calorie target is not part of matching). The track's first program is **assigned, not started** — start it with POST /v1/fitness/programs/{program}/start. Calling this again while the answers still match the same track keeps the current program. `program_changed` (top-level) is true when the account's current program changed.

Run the PATCH profile cases above (steps 1-3) with the SAME token first so gender/birth_date/height_cm/weight_kg/fitness_level/goal/workout_location are all set before calling this for the success case.

item.name: List Programs
item.description:
Active fitness programs for the Fitness Homepage ("Your Program" + "General Programs" sections).

Each program carries `state` ({value,label}) for the account — see the field description.

query.description: Collapses bilingual (name_ar/name_en) fields into a single localized `name` string. Defaults to config('app.locale') (en) when omitted or not one of the supported values — safe to omit entirely.

item.name: Get My Track
item.description:
The track matched to the account, with its full ordered list of programs (by difficulty_level then priority). 404 if no track assigned yet.

A track is matched on the profile's `gender`, `goal`, `fitness_level` and `workout_location` (`location_type` here); a null criterion on the track accepts any value.

Each program in the track carries `state` ({value,label}): assigned | running | completed | in_queue | unenrolled.

item.name: Get My Programs
item.description:
Every active program in the account's track, each tagged with its state, plus `completed_weeks` out of `total_weeks`. Read-only — never auto-advances (unlike Get My Current Program).

`state` ({value,label}): assigned | running | completed | in_queue | unenrolled. `assigned` = the account's current program, not started yet (started_at null) — start it with POST /v1/fitness/programs/{program}/start.

`unenrolled`: the account was unenrolled from the program — it can't be started again and track progression skips it.

`completed_weeks`: weeks whose days are all completed — computed for the running program; equals total_weeks for completed programs; 0 otherwise. `total_weeks` = the program's weeks_count.

query.description: Filter by state: running | completed | in_queue | unenrolled. Any other value → 422.

item.name: Get My Current Program
item.description:
The account's current program — the one it is running, or the one assigned to it and not started yet (`state` = assigned, `program_cta_label` = "Start Program"). This call never starts a program: start it with POST /v1/fitness/programs/{program}/start.

Once the running program is finished (every day completed) this advances to the next program in the track and returns it **assigned, not started** — it continues with the program after the finished one in track order, skipping unenrolled programs; after a general program (no track) it resumes from the first unfinished program in the track.

404 with "No programs available for you right now" once the whole track is completed, when no track is assigned, or when only unenrolled programs are left.

Progress is completion-based, not calendar-based: completed_weeks counts weeks whose days are all completed, program_progress_percentage = completed days / all days, is_program_complete once every day is completed, current_week = the week of the first not-completed day, and current_day_id = that day's id. Time passing alone never moves the account forward.

Response body is the same shape as GET v1/fitness/programs/{program}, plus current_week and current_day_id, with two differences:

- `attributes` are display-ready `{ key, icon, text }` (text localized by ?locale=, e.g. "12 تمرين"); keys: weeks_count, difficulty_level, location_type, exercises_count, duration (admin-entered). An attribute is omitted when it has no value. `icon` is null for now. (GET programs/{program} keeps `{ key, value }`.)
- `intro_video`: program-level intro video `{ id, title, image_url, video_url, attributes, is_locked }` (is_locked = subscription lock), or null.

`is_subscription_locked`: true when the account is not subscribed. `is_locked` is its deprecated alias.

query.description: Collapses bilingual (name_ar/name_en) fields into a single localized `name` string. Defaults to config('app.locale') (en) when omitted or not one of the supported values — safe to omit entirely.

item.name: Get Program
item.description:
Program detail, including progress state, catch image, and subscription lock state.

`state` ({value,label}): assigned | running | completed | in_queue | unenrolled. `assigned` = the account's current program, not started yet (started_at null) — start it with POST /v1/fitness/programs/{program}/start. Null for programs outside the account's track.

Progress is completion-based, not calendar-based: completed_weeks counts weeks whose days are all completed, program_progress_percentage = completed days / all days, is_program_complete once every day is completed, current_week = the week of the first not-completed day, and current_day_id = that day's id. Time passing alone never moves the account forward. Progress fields are zero / null for a program that isn't the account's started program; `program_cta_label` is "Start Program" until it is started, then "Continue", and "Restart Program" once complete.

`is_subscription_locked`: true when the account is not subscribed. `is_locked` is its deprecated alias.

query.description: Collapses bilingual (name_ar/name_en) fields into a single localized `name` string. Defaults to config('app.locale') (en) when omitted or not one of the supported values — safe to omit entirely.

item.name: Start Program
item.description:
Starts a program for the account — the only way a program is started (onboarding, track re-matching and track progression only assign one). Typically called with the account's assigned program (GET /v1/account/program). Calling it again for the program that is already running is a no-op. Starting a program the account ran before starts it from scratch (its previous progress is cleared).

Rejected with 403:
- `program_not_in_track` — the program belongs to a track other than the account's (programs from the account's own track, general programs with no track, or any program when the account has no track yet, are allowed).
- `program_unenrolled` — the account was unenrolled from this program (see Unenroll From Current Program).

`is_subscription_locked`: true when the account is not subscribed. `is_locked` is its deprecated alias.

item.name: Unenroll From Current Program
item.description:
Empty request, token only. Unenrolls the account from its current program: the profile is left with no program (its track is kept) and the program's state becomes `unenrolled` everywhere it is shown.

- Starting that program again returns 403 `program_unenrolled`.
- On the next GET v1/account/program, track progression skips it and starts the next program in the track, or returns 404 if none is left.
- An admin can cancel the unenroll from Filament (profile → Program History → Cancel Unenroll).

Always 200 — `message` tells whether there was a program to unenroll from.

item.name: List Exercises
item.description: Exercises (videos) for the "Videos Grid View", optionally filtered by muscle_group_id and/or program_day_id, plus a general_tips collection (featured fitness articles) for the same screen. Not touched by the gap-analysis PR — no attributes[]/is_locked here (those are added only in the workout-day context by ProgramDayExerciseResource).

item.name: Get Weekly Schedule
item.description:
The days of one program week with per-day completion and lock status. A week has 1–7 days (set by the admin per week), so the number of items varies; there are no rest days and no dates.

Pass `day_id` to get the program week containing that day; otherwise the week the account is currently in (the week of its first not-completed day) is returned. `date`/`from`/`to` are no longer used and are ignored.

`status`: upcoming | in_progress | completed. A day is `in_progress` as soon as any of its exercises is logged (even if not completed yet). For a full week with exercises and tracking use GET …/weeks/{weekNumber}.

409 `program_not_started` while the program is assigned but not started.

query.description: A program_day id. Returns the days of the program week containing that day. 404 workout_day_not_found if the day is not part of the account's current program.

item.name: Get Program Week
item.description:
One program week of the account's current program: week metadata plus every day of the week (1–7 days, set by the admin per week; no rest days), each with its exercises and exercise-level tracking (target, the user's log, status) and similar exercises for swapping. No dates — days are addressed by their id.

`{program}` must be the account's current program (otherwise 404 program_not_assigned); 409 program_not_started while it is assigned but not started.

Status values — week: upcoming | in_progress | completed; day: upcoming | in_progress | completed; exercise: not_started | in_progress | completed.

Use `days[].id` as `{day}` in GET …/days/{day}, PUT …/days/{day}/exercises/{exerciseId} and POST …/days/{day}/complete.

query.description: ar | en. Localizes the week title. Defaults to en.

variable.description: Numeric program id (must be the account's current program).

item.name: [Removed] Get Workout Day
item.description:
**Removed — use GET /v1/fitness/programs/{program}/days/{day} (takes the program day id instead of a date).** Dates are no longer accepted on this route (404).

Daily workout detail — intro video, exercises grouped by phase, day progress, and per-exercise lock state, tracking and similar exercises.

`exercises.*.id` is the **program-day exercise id** (send it in PUT …/exercises/{exerciseId}); exercise objects carry no video id. `exercise` / `attributes` / `tracking.target` come from this day's target for the exercise, not from the video.

Locking (`exercises.*.is_locked`): a day is locked when the previous training day isn't completed, or when the previous program week still has an incomplete training day — same rule as `is_locked` on the weekly schedule.

item.name: [Removed] Log Exercise
item.description:
**Removed — use PUT /v1/fitness/programs/{program}/days/{day}/exercises/{exerciseId} (takes the program day id instead of a date).** Dates are no longer accepted on this route (404).

Logs the user's performance for one program-day exercise and returns the updated exercise and day progress. Each call **replaces** the stored log for that exercise/date (send the full list of sets every time).

`{exerciseId}` = `exercises[].id` from GET …/days/{date} or GET …/weeks/{weekNumber}.

Body depends on the exercise's `tracking.type`:
- **reps**: `sets` = [{ index, reps, weight_kg }]
- **duration**: `duration_seconds` (alias: `duration`)
- **cardio**: `duration_seconds`, `distance_km`, `speed_kmh`

Fields that don't belong to the type → 422 `tracking_type_mismatch`.

`similar_exercise_id` (optional): the user swapped to one of this exercise's `similar_exercises[].id`; omit/null when they did the exercise itself (omitting it clears a previous swap). Not one of them → 422 `similar_exercise_not_found`.

`is_completed` (optional): when omitted it is derived from the target — reps: logged sets ≥ target sets; duration/cardio: seconds ≥ target seconds.

variable.description: Program-day exercise id (exercises[].id from the day/week responses) — not a video id.

item.name: Get Workout Day
item.description:
Daily workout detail — intro video, exercises grouped by phase, day progress, and per-exercise lock state, tracking and similar exercises.

`{day}` is the **program day id** (not a date): days[].id from GET …/weeks/{weekNumber}, program_day_id from GET …/schedule, or current_day_id from GET /v1/account/program. Unknown id → 404; a day outside the account's current program → 404 `workout_day_not_found`; a date in its place → 404. 409 `program_not_started` while the program is assigned but not started.

`exercises.*.id` is the **program-day exercise id** (send it in PUT …/exercises/{exerciseId}); exercise objects carry no video id. `exercise` / `attributes` / `tracking.target` come from this day's target for the exercise, not from the video.

Locking (`exercises.*.is_locked`): a day is locked when the previous day isn't completed, or when the previous program week still has an incomplete day — same rule as `is_locked` on the weekly schedule.

variable.description: Program day id: days[].id from GET …/weeks/{weekNumber}, program_day_id from GET …/schedule, or current_day_id from GET /v1/account/program. Must belong to the account's current program. A date is not accepted.

item.name: [Removed] Complete Workout Day
item.description:
**Removed — use POST /v1/fitness/programs/{program}/days/{day}/complete (takes the program day id instead of a date).** Dates are no longer accepted on this route (404).

Marks the entire workout day complete, or reverts it back to incomplete.

item.name: Complete Workout Day
item.description:
Marks the entire workout day complete, or reverts it back to incomplete. Progress is per program day, so the day can be completed on any date.

`{day}` is the **program day id** (not a date): days[].id from GET …/weeks/{weekNumber}, program_day_id from GET …/schedule, or current_day_id from GET /v1/account/program. Unknown id → 404; a day outside the account's current program → 404 `workout_day_not_found`; a date in its place → 404. 409 `program_not_started` while the program is assigned but not started.

variable.description: Program day id: days[].id from GET …/weeks/{weekNumber}, program_day_id from GET …/schedule, or current_day_id from GET /v1/account/program. Must belong to the account's current program. A date is not accepted.
